issues.claim: The whole MedSpa Compass block (Ohana Medical Spa, Rewind Bar Med Spa, Remedi Day Spa, The Park MedSpa, Infinite Medical Group, Ace Aesthetics, AlyneMD, Brunswick Medi Spa, LenoyMED at Metuchen)
issues.problem: That directory's 'Edison' page is a metro/radius list, not a town list. At least nine of these businesses are physically outside Edison: Ohana Medical Spa -> 1767 East Second St, Scotch Plains 07076; Rewind Bar -> 907 Oak Tree Ave, South Plainfield 07080; Remedi Day Spa -> 4906 Arthur Kill Rd, Staten Island NY 10309; The Park MedSpa -> 85 Raritan Ave, Highland Park 08904; Infinite Medical Group -> 172 Summerhill Rd, East Brunswick 08816; Ace Aesthetics -> 125 Washington Valley Rd, Warren 07059; AlyneMD -> Warren NJ (site markets Warren + New York); Brunswick Medi Spa -> 646 Route 18, East Brunswick; LenoyMED at Metuchen -> 326 Main St, Metuchen 08840. They do not operate in the zone.
issues.fix: Delete all nine, or re-verify each against its own website address before reinstating. Replace with Edison-address med spas confirmed from primary sites (e.g. Associates in Plastic Surgery, 1150 Amboy Ave; Santhigram, 1681 NJ-27 / 1700 Oak Tree Rd; Medical Laser & Skin Rejuvenation Center).

issues.claim: Oak Tree Animal Clinic, 2122 Oak Tree Rd, Edison
issues.problem: The practice's own website lists 904 Oak Tree Rd, Suite D, South Plainfield NJ 07080 with phone (732) 548-4411 - the same phone as the entry. The Edison address appears only in older directory listings (with a different phone, 732-548-1276). The business is in South Plainfield, not Edison.
issues.fix: Remove, or move to the South Plainfield zone.

issues.claim: Howard Moses, DMD, LLC (817 Inman Ave Suite 2, (732) 499-7300) and Tina Panchal DMD, LLC ((732) 499-7300)
issues.problem: Duplicate office. drtinapanchal.com gives the practice address as 817 Inman Ave #2, Edison 08820 - the same suite and the same phone number as the Howard Moses entry. This is one location recorded twice under two provider names.
issues.fix: Merge into one record (Tina Panchal DMD is the current website/brand) and drop the duplicate.

issues.claim: Gina Hering, PA-C, 102 James St, Suite 202
issues.problem: Not a separate business. iT Aesthetix's own provider page lists Gina Hering, PA-C as its aesthetic injector at 80 James St, 2nd Floor, Edison - and iT Aesthetix is already entry 95 of the list. The 102 James St address is not supported by the cited source.
issues.fix: Delete as a duplicate of It Aesthetix, or record her only as a contact at that practice.

issues.problem: Real Edison office, but it is one branch of a multi-location dental group - mybeamdental.com lists offices in Flushing, Long Island City, Union Square, Williamsburg, Edgewater, Edison, Fort Lee, Hoboken, Jersey City and more. That is the chain/franchise pattern the mapper excluded (Aspen Dental, Diamond Braces).
issues.fix: Remove under the chains/franchises exclusion, or get an explicit call from the orchestrator that multi-site DSOs are in scope.

issues.claim: Roughly 40 entries recorded with address 'Unknown' (optometrists, med spas, counselors, paediatric practices)
issues.problem: A zone list where the address is unknown cannot be shown to be in the zone, and several of the 'Unknown' med spa entries turned out to be in other towns. 'Unknown' is not evidence of zone membership.
issues.fix: Require a town-confirming address (or explicit 'serves Edison, office in X') from the business's own site or a listing before carrying an entry forward.

issues.problem: Two Edison optometrists surfaced immediately and are absent: Dr. Erol Dogan, OD (2210 Route 27) and Dr. Howard Hertz, OD (1199 Amboy Ave). The optometry block is thin relative to the other categories.
issues.fix: Add them and run a proper optometry pass.
